events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable showman, Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, "Rubber Soul," on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly changed the game for pop music. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon was tragically killed in New York City.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost a true visionary. John Lennon's music and message live on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Iconic musician and cultural chameleon David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The legendary David Bowie would have been celebrating his 80th birthday today. A true innovator, forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: Elvis Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard himself, Jimmy Page! What a legacy.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1945.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still got that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs from Madness, was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: It's a happy 66th birthday to the legendary Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English pop singer Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1956.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got us feeling the rhythm.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her birthday today. She was born in 1946.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the queen of country, Dolly Parton! Still working 9 to 5 and beyond.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1971.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Still got the magic touch.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1950.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday! What a legend.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first ceremony
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on this day in 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Rock Hall First Ceremony
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors for the very first induction ceremony. A proper moment in music history.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer Mark Owen celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1972.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen from Take That! Still got those moves.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles played their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1951.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! Still drumming up a storm.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1960.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British charmer, Hugh Grant! Still making us swoon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former *NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1981.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! Still bringing SexyBack.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason, known for his roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1940.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 years on
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Day The Music Died Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost three legends in 'The Day The Music Died'. Their songs live on forever.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famed for his 80s hits and viral comeback, celebrates his birthday today. He was born in 1966.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down... and always gonna wish Rick Astley a happy 61st birthday!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King, known for "Tapestry," celebrates her birthday today. She was born in 1942.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the phenomenal Carole King! Her songs are the soundtrack to so many lives.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: On this day in 2012, the world lost the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston at the age of 48.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. Whitney Houston, forever missed.

events.title: Take That's original split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop phenomenon Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-one years ago today, the world mourned as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! Still bringing the sunshine with those reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! Still dominating the charts.
